kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تستشهدن (form X)
# تَسْتَشْهِدْنَ (tastašhidna) /tas.taʃ.hid.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# تُسْتَشْهَدْنَ (tustašhadna) /tus.taʃ.had.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
